text: Caught up with Pooja after standup. Her manager Gabriel is leaving end of the month and she's been asked to cover his clients until they hire. She sounded stretched but kind of excited about it.

Kate's knee replacement is booked for November 12th. Her husband Theo is taking two weeks off to look after her. She's nervous about the anaesthetic more than the op itself. Need to send her something nice the week after.

Lunch with Julien. His daughter Isla started reception in September and apparently cried every morning for a fortnight, but she's fine now and has a best friend called Mia. Julien's wife Sinead is back at work full time from early March.
Mei got her A level results sorted, Durham is a go. Her mum Yuki was in tears on the phone. They're driving up together sometime in late September. Don't forget to get Mei a card before she leaves.
Abdi called. His dad had a stent put in on Tuesday and is home already, walking round the garden. Abdi's flying back to Leeds sometime next week to help out.
Rahul's presentation to the Okafor account is 11/3. He's dreading it, the client's procurement guy tore his last deck apart. Text him good luck the night before.
Quick one: dentist moved to Oct 29, 8.40. Also pick up prescription Friday.
Hannah's graduating from her nursing degree on December 6th! Her parents are coming over from Cork for it. She wants a decent stethoscope, hint hint, the Littmann one.
Emil Jensen from finance is off for a hernia op, back mid November apparently. Lukas is covering his approvals in the meantime, so invoices go to him now.
Anil and Demi's son Ben did his first swimming badge on Saturday. Anil was more nervous watching than Ben was swimming. They're doing a little party for his 6th birthday on November 2nd.

Coffee with Krisztina. Her new boss Vanessa is micromanaging everything and Kriszti is properly fed up, looking at other jobs over the summer if it doesn't improve. Her mum's hip surgery went well last week though, recovering at Krisztina's flat. Need to check in on her mum's recovery sometime next week, maybe pop round with soup.
Gintaras says the client offsite in Lisbon is cancelled, budget got pulled. He's gutted, he'd planned to bring his wife Kasia along for a long weekend after.
Layla had her wisdom teeth out on 10/14 and still looks like a hamster, her words. Off work till Monday. I should drop round some ice cream.
Saanvi's daughter Eilidh starts secondary school in the autumn and they've just found out she got into the grammar. Saanvi is over the moon. Eilidh wants a proper fountain pen for her first day.
Ahmed had his performance review yesterday, got the promotion to senior engineer. Starts the new role on January 5th. Takes his team out for drinks Friday.

Talked to Joanna about her dad. He's in St James's after a fall, broken wrist and they're keeping him in for observation. She's been driving there every evening after work and is exhausted. Remind me to ring her on Thursday.
Jess's twins, Hemi and Sadia, both sat their 11 plus on the 9th. Results come out end of October. Jess is a wreck about it, the boys seem totally unbothered.
Theo's leaving do is Dec 18th at the Crown. He's been at the firm eleven years. Chip in for the collection, Pooja's sorting it.
Gabriel mentioned his wife Mei is expecting their second, due early April. Their eldest, Lukas, is starting nursery in January so it's all happening at once for them.
Note to self: renew passport before end of the month, booked the trip for March 3rd.
Isla Murphy, Izzy to everyone in the office, has her driving test on November 7th. Third attempt. She's terrified. Need to wish her luck the day before.
Kasia's cat Bubbles had to have a tooth out at the vet on Monday. Kasia was more stressed than the cat. All fine now, eating again.
Vanessa from HR had a minor op on her shoulder over half term. Back in the office but can't lift anything. Her partner Ben is doing all the school runs for their kids for now.

Rang Uncle Anil. Scan results came back clear on 10/16, huge relief. He and Auntie Saanvi are celebrating with a trip to Kerala sometime over Christmas. Must call him next week to sort a date for dinner before they go.
Demi said her brother Julien finished his PhD viva on Friday, passed with minor corrections. Graduation's next summer. She's really proud of him.
Hannah's dog Pepper got lost on the common Sunday but turned up at the pub two hours later. Hannah's still shaken.

Big catch-up with the team at lunch. Sinead's off for her hysterectomy from November 20th, probably six weeks. Rahul is taking over her clients, which he's quietly worried about. Abdi's paternity leave starts sometime in December, baby due around the 10th. And Kate is finally back from her secondment end of next week. Busy winter. I should organise cards for both Sinead and Abdi before they go.
Yuki's son Gintaras starts at the new school on 11/4 after they moved from Bristol. He's quite anxious about not knowing anyone.
Mia's wedding is off. She and Theo split up last month, she's staying with her sister Layla for now. Didn't want to talk about it much.
Lukas is a vegetarian, and his wife Joanna is coeliac. Remember for the Christmas dinner.
Krisztina's first day at Baker & Co was today. Says her new manager Ahmed seems lovely and her desk is by a window, which she'd been after for years.
Physio for my ankle every Tuesday until early December. Moved my gym membership to pause.
Anil's mum is in hospital again with pneumonia. He's been there since Saturday. Text him tonight to see how she's doing.
Sadia's son Emil had his first day at uni last week, Edinburgh, studying architecture. She says the house is way too quiet. Her husband keeps setting four places at dinner.
Pooja and Gabriel are celebrating ten years married on June 3rd. They're thinking Italy. She said she'd love one of those star map prints of the night they met.
Spoke with Dr Khan's receptionist. My follow-up is now May 14. Bring the old scans.

Hemi's in a bad way, the redundancy consultation starts sometime next week and half his team are at risk. His partner Jess is pregnant too so the timing couldn't be worse. Don't forget to message him after the first meeting.
Eilidh did her grade 5 piano exam on Saturday, thinks it went okay. Results end of the month. Her teacher Mrs Patel was really pleased with her scales.
Ben's knee surgery got pushed back again, now looking like early February. He's frustrated, can't play football or do much at all. His girlfriend Sinead has been brilliant apparently.
Mei mentioned her boss Kate Ito is retiring at Christmas after thirty years. Big do planned for December 19th, everyone from the old Manchester office is coming.
Vanessa's daughter Layla graduated from Leeds on July 12th, first class in law. Starting a training contract in the autumn. Vanessa sent me about forty photos.
Abdi's partner Kasia had their baby girl yesterday, Amira, 7lb 2. Both doing well. Send flowers this week.
Called Julien. He's still recovering from the gallbladder op, sleeping a lot. His sister Hannah is staying with him until the end of the month. He said the hospital food was the worst part.
Gintaras is learning Japanese for a trip to Osaka over the summer, practising with Yuki at lunch every Wednesday.
Rahul says client meeting with Patel Logistics went really well, they signed for another year. His boss Theo bought the whole team pizza.
Kate's son Gabriel finishes his GCSEs in June. He wants to do an apprenticeship with an electrician. Kate's not sure, she'd rather he did A levels.
Must book the car in for its MOT before 11/28.
Ahmed Khan, the new client lead, is starting May 1st. Saanvi says he's ex Deloitte and very sharp. Set up a coffee with him the first week.

Joanna's mum had a mini stroke over the weekend. She's at the Royal for tests, scan on Wednesday. Jo's trying to keep it together but she's not sleeping. I need to ring her after the scan to see what they found.

Hannah and Lukas are moving in together end of the month, a flat in Walthamstow. They're having a housewarming sometime in November. Hannah said they need literally everything, especially a decent set of pans.
Mia's starting a part time MBA in early March alongside her job. Her manager Emil is letting her do Fridays off. She's nervous about the maths bits.
Jess's boss Ben Okafor told her she's up for team lead. Interview is 12/2. She's quietly confident.
Did the school pick up for Sinead today since she's at her hospital appointment. Her little boy Theo told me all about the class hamster.
Demi passed her driving test on Friday on the first go! Her dad's letting her borrow his car over the summer. Need to send a congrats message.
Pooja's dad has his cataract op on November 5th, then the other eye sometime early in the new year. She's taking him to both. Her brother Rahul lives in Dubai so it's all on her.
Eilidh's tortoise Gerald is fifty. She's throwing him a party, no joke, on Sunday.

Krisztina said her son Hemi has his university interviews for medicine in early December, Oxford on Dec 9 and King's the week after. He's been doing mock interviews with her husband every night. He's really nervous about Oxford. Text Hemi good luck the day before, and ask Krisztina on the 10th how it went.

Long chat with Layla. She's been signed off with stress for two weeks, her manager Vanessa keeps piling things on. Her doctor wants her to try counselling. She's also helping her son Abdi with uni applications, deadline end of January. Check in with her sometime next week.
Groceries, bin day moved to Thursday, call the boiler guy.

Saanvi's husband Anil had his hip done on October 8th and is already off the crutches. She says he's a terrible patient though, keeps trying to mow the lawn. Physio twice a week till Christmas. Their daughter Isla graduates from Bath on 7/18 next year and he's determined to walk her down to the ceremony without a stick.
